# Built-in themes

Here's the same map in each of them. Pick a theme to switch; the editor stays live, so you can try a theme by using it.

<LiveMapper map={orderMap} input={orderInput} height={460} themeSwitcher open={{options: false, data: false}} />

Pick a theme with the `theme` option, or switch at any time with `mapper.setTheme()`:

```ts
const mapper = createMapper(element, { document: map, theme: "nord" });
mapper.setTheme("paper");
```

## Crosswalk's own

| Theme | Look |
|---|---|
| `ink` | The default. Ink on paper, like office paperwork: a plain page, lines in ink, and operators as highlighter-yellow tiles stamped in ink. Follows light or dark mode. These docs use it. |
| `studio` | Clean and neutral, with curved links and a colour for each kind of operator. Follows the system's light or dark mode. |
| `classic` | A traditional mapping tool: square tiles, straight lines and a ruled grid. Follows light or dark mode. |
| `blueprint` | Always dark: a drafting grid, right-angled links and monospace labels. |
| `paper` | Always light: warm and quiet, with round tiles, no grid and a serif face. |

## Editor colour schemes

These follow well-known code editor schemes, with each scheme's own colours on the operator tiles.

| Theme | Scheme |
|---|---|
| `github-light` | GitHub's light colours. |
| `solarized-light`, `solarized-dark` | Ethan Schoonover's Solarized. |
| `one-dark` | Atom's One Dark. |
| `dracula` | Dracula. |
| `nord` | Nord. |
| `gruvbox-dark` | Gruvbox, dark, with straight links. |
| `monokai` | Monokai. |
| `tokyo-night` | Tokyo Night. |

:::tip Light and dark
`ink`, `studio` and `classic` follow the operating system's light or dark setting. If your app has its own switch, use a theme with a fixed scheme for each mode, or make your own pair: [Your own themes](./custom-themes.md#fixing-light-or-dark) shows how.
:::

`themes`, exported from `@crosswalkjs/canvas`, lists these definitions, with a `label`, `description` and `group` for building a picker. `listThemes()` also includes themes you've registered.
